subject: general
question: The materials through which objects can be seen, but not clearly are known as ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** translucent materials.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Translucent materials** allow light to pass through them, but they **scatter the light,** making objects **appear blurry or hazy.**
 
• Examples of translucent materials include** frosted glass, wax paper, and some plastics**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Conducting materials,** such as metals, allow **electricity **to flow through them easily.
 
• **Transparent materials,** such as clear glass or plastic, allow light to pass through them **without scattering,** making objects appear clear and sharp.
 
• **Opaque materials,** such as **wood or metal**, do not allow light to pass through them at all.
